notes.title: Dungeon Renovators Playtest #3 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Dungeon Renovators Playtest #3 Notes[/h1]
Welcome to Playtest #3! There are a few fundamental changes to this build as well as the usual bugfixes, tweaks, improvements, and cult classic requests.


[olist]
[*] The hero now walks and runs faster but running requires [LSHIFT] or (X) on a xbox-style controller.
[*] There is now a storage station for mid/upper-tier wood products
[*] Rats and cold do half the damage they used to.
[*] You'll see a new poster in the Metro that reveals the next Boss fight
[*] Power attacks, running, and dodge/roll use up Stamina. 
[/olist]

In Playtest #4, we're hoping to have an expanded tutorial/intro area and a new boss fight...

notes.title: Second Playtest build now live!
notes.content: The new playtest build has lots of fixes, more tutorials, and a little bit of extra polish. It's still a pre-Alpha build though! Be sure to use the feedback form if you have any issues or suggestions.

notes.title: Update Notes for First Playtest!
notes.content: This is the first Dungeon Renovators playtest! Note that this is a very early build: art and animation is mostly placeholder, and not all features are in the game yet. So why let people play it? We want to make sure that the game is shaping up to be fun and that we're headed in the right direction. It's important that we find out what people like most (and don't like) before it's too late to make changes. At the end, be sure to hit F12 to submit feedback on what you liked and what changes or additions you'd like to see. Also, note that this playtest should work pretty well with gamepads.
